svg.title: White Angle Over Black
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-last-paintings-05-2017/lightbox/works/white-angle-over-black-2015-42886; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
